title: 第21章 出大事了得立刻禀报师父第22章 是
slug: 每日情报从打渔人开始武道通神
lines: 草屋内。
郑氏捏着两张泛黄的借据，仍然难以置信：
“大郎…咱家欠的账，当真就这么两清了？”
“两清了。”
沈修寒笑着点头。
郑氏捧着借据，看了又看，忽然起身，将其扔进火塘。
火光一卷，纸笺瞬时燃起，化作点点飞灰，飘飘摇摇升上半空，又缓缓落下。
郑氏盯着灰烬出神，佝偻的后背一点点挺直，仿佛背上的重担也随着这缕青烟消散了。
“锅锅…”
床角传来怯生生的童音。
沈沫沫缩成小小一团，像只受了惊的鹌鹑，小声道：
“大坏蛋都走了吗？他、他不会抓沫沫了吧？”
沈修寒心头一软，走过去将她揽进怀里。
白家人会不会再来，他不知道，但最好别再来…
因为，下一次沈修寒绝不会让他们安然无恙地离去。
“都走了。”沈修寒轻声道，“再也不会来了。”
顿了顿，他变戏法似的摸出两根糖葫芦，晃了晃：“看，兄长为沫沫带了什么？”
晶莹的糖稀裹着红艳艳的山楂，被一根竹签串起，在昏黄的灯火下泛着诱人的光。
“糖葫芦！”
小丫头眼睛倏地亮了，惊惧一扫而光，一下子从他怀里蹦起来，接过便是一大口。
“好甜噢…”
“娘，糖葫芦好好吃哦！”
郑氏看着女儿欢喜的模样，终于再也忍不住，偏过头去，用手背悄悄抹眼泪。
“娘，别哭了。”
沈修寒指了指买来的猪五花，笑道：“快些做饭吧，儿子练了一天武，饿得前胸贴后背。”
“好，好，娘这就去做。”郑氏擦干泪，起身忙活去了。
饭间。
香气弥漫。
一碗肉粥配一张棒子面饼，吃得人浑身发暖。
郑氏平复了心绪，轻声问道：“大郎，今日去武馆可还顺遂？”
“娘放心，一切顺利。”
沈修寒从怀里掏出梅霜风给的荷包，递过去：“卖宝鱼剩下的银两，娘快些收好罢。”
“你练武消耗大，得留些钱在身上傍身。”
“留了的。”
沈修寒笑了笑，他贴身留了二两碎银，以备不时之需。
郑氏这才接过往里头看了一眼，白花花的银锭让她有些目眩，呼吸一滞，筷子都顾不上放，忙将荷包藏进床下。
沈沫沫吃着肉粥，也放不下糖葫芦，含糊不清地道：
“锅锅，是不是学武就不怕那些抓沫沫的大坏蛋了？”
“自然。”
“那…那沫沫长大了也要练武功，帮锅锅打坏人！”
content_en:
Inside the thatched house.
Zheng held the two yellowed IOUs, still in disbelief:
"Da Lang...are we really going to settle all the debts our family owes?"
"It's settled."
Shen Xiuhan smiled and nodded.
Mrs. Zheng held the IOU, looked at it again and again, suddenly stood up and threw it into the fire pit.
With a flicker of fire, the paper ignited instantly and turned into little bits of fly ash, fluttering up into the air and falling slowly again.
Mrs. Zheng stared at the ashes in trance, her rickety back straightened little by little, as if the heavy burden on her back had dissipated with the wisp of smoke.
"Guo Guo..."
A timid childish voice came from the corner of the bed.
Shen Momo huddled up into a small ball, like a frightened quail, and whispered:
"Have the big bad guys left? He, he won't catch Momo, right?"
Shen Xiuhan's heart softened and he walked over and took her into his arms.
He didn't know if the Bai family would come again, but it was best not to come again...
Because next time, Shen Xiuhan would never let them leave safely.
"They are all gone." Shen Xiuhan said softly, "They will never come again."
After a pause, he magically took out two candied haws and shook them: "Look, what did brother bring for Momo?"
The bright red hawthorns are wrapped in crystal sugar syrup and strung up on a bamboo stick, glowing seductively under the dim light.
"Candied haws!"
The little girl's eyes suddenly lit up, and her fear was swept away. She jumped up from his arms and took a big mouthful.
"So sweet..."
"Mom, the candied haws on a stick is so delicious!"
Mrs. Zheng looked at her daughter's happy expression and finally couldn't bear it any longer. She turned her head and wiped her tears quietly with the back of her hand.
"Mom, stop crying."
Shen Xiuhan pointed at the pork belly he bought and said with a smile: "Let's cook quickly. My son has been practicing martial arts for a day and is so hungry that his chest is touching his back."
"Okay, okay, mother, let's do it now." Mrs. Zheng wiped away her tears, got up and went to work.
Dining room.
The fragrance fills the air.
A bowl of meat porridge with a piece of stick noodle will make you feel warm all over.
Zheng calmed down and asked softly: "Dalang, did you go to the martial arts gym smoothly today?"
"Don't worry, Mom, everything goes well."
Shen Xiuhan took out the purse Mei Shuangfeng gave him from his arms and handed it over: "Mom, hurry up and collect the remaining silver from selling Baoyu."
"You spend a lot of time practicing martial arts, so you have to keep some money with you."
"Keep it."
Shen Xiuhan smiled and kept two taels of silver on his body for emergencies.
Mrs. Zheng then took it and took a look inside. She was a little dazzled by the white silver ingots. Her breath was stagnant and she didn't even bother to put down her chopsticks. She hurriedly hid her purse under the bed.
Shen Momo was eating meat porridge, but couldn't put down the candied haws, and said vaguely:
"Guo Guo, are you learning martial arts and not afraid of those big bad guys who want to catch Momo?"
"Natural."
"Then...then Momo will also practice martial arts when she grows up and help Guo Guo fight bad guys!"
"Okay!"
